title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Procuratorial Public Interest Litigation Cases

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Interpretation is formulated for the purpose of correctly applying the provisions of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China concerning the system of public interest litigation instituted by the People's Procuratorate, and in light of the actual circumstances of adjudication and procuratorial work.

Article 2 The primary tasks of the People's Court and the People's Procuratorate in handling public interest litigation cases are to fully give play to the functions of judicial adjudication and legal supervision, uphold the authority of the Constitution and laws, safeguard social fairness and justice, protect national interests and social public interests, urge qualified subjects to exercise the right to public interest litigation according to law, and promote law-based administration and strict enforcement of law.

Article 3 In handling public interest litigation cases, the People's Court and the People's Procuratorate shall abide by the provisions of the Constitution and laws, follow the principles of the litigation system, and follow the operational rules of adjudicative power and procuratorial power.

Article 4 Where the People's Procuratorate institutes public interest litigation as a public interest litigant, it shall enjoy the corresponding litigation rights and perform the corresponding litigation obligations in accordance with the Civil Procedure Law and the Administrative Procedure Law, except as otherwise provided by laws and judicial interpretations.

Article 5 A first-instance civil public interest litigation case instituted by a People's Procuratorate of a city (branch, prefecture) shall be under the jurisdiction of the Intermediate People's Court of the place where the tortious act was committed or where the defendant has its domicile.
A first-instance administrative public interest litigation case instituted by a Primary People's Procuratorate shall be under the jurisdiction of the Primary People's Court in the place where the administrative organ sued is located.

Article 6 In handling public interest litigation cases, the People's Procuratorate may investigate and collect evidentiary materials from relevant administrative organs, other organizations, and citizens; the relevant administrative organs, other organizations, and citizens shall cooperate; where it is necessary to take evidence preservation measures, the relevant provisions of the Civil Procedure Law and the Administrative Procedure Law shall apply.
Article 7 Where the People's Court tries a first-instance public interest litigation case instituted by the People's Procuratorate, the people's assessor system shall apply.

Article 8 Where the People's Court holds a hearing to try a public interest litigation case instituted by the People's Procuratorate, it shall serve a notice of appearance in court on the People's Procuratorate three days before the hearing.
The People's Procuratorate shall send personnel to appear in court and shall, within three days from receipt of the notice of appearance in court from the People's Court, submit to the People's Court a notice of dispatch of personnel to appear in court. The notice of dispatch of personnel to appear in court shall state the names, legal posts, and specific duties to be performed in court of the appearing personnel.
Article 10 Where the People's Procuratorate is dissatisfied with a first-instance judgment or ruling of the People's Court, it may file an appeal with the People's Court at the next higher level.

Article 11 Where the People's Court tries a case at second instance, the People's Procuratorate that instituted the public interest litigation shall send personnel to appear in court, and the People's Procuratorate at the next higher level may also send personnel to participate.

Article 12 Where a judgment or ruling of a public interest litigation case instituted by the People's Procuratorate becomes legally effective and the defendant fails to perform it, the People's Court shall transfer it for enforcement.
II. Civil Public Interest Litigation

Article 13 Where, in the performance of its duties, the People's Procuratorate discovers conduct that damages ecological environment and resource protection, infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of numerous consumers in the field of food and drug safety, or infringes upon the names, portraits, reputations, honors, etc. of heroes and martyrs, thereby harming social public interests, and it intends to institute public interest litigation, it shall make a public announcement according to law for a period of thirty days.
Upon expiration of the announcement period, if the organs prescribed by law, relevant organizations, and the close relatives of heroes and martyrs, etc. do not institute litigation, the People's Procuratorate may institute litigation with the People's Court.
In handling civil public interest litigation cases involving infringement upon the names, portraits, reputations, honors, etc. of heroes and martyrs, the People's Procuratorate may also directly consult the opinions of the close relatives of heroes and martyrs, etc.

Article 15 Where the People's Procuratorate institutes civil public interest litigation pursuant to the provisions of Article 55, paragraph 2 of the Civil Procedure Law, and the prosecution conditions prescribed in items 2, 3, and 4 of Article 119 of the Civil Procedure Law and in this Interpretation are satisfied, the People's Court shall register and docket the case.
Article 16 In a civil public interest litigation case instituted by the People's Procuratorate, where the defendant raises claims by way of counterclaim, the People's Court shall not accept it.

Article 17 After accepting a civil public interest litigation case instituted by the People's Procuratorate, the People's Court shall serve a copy of the complaint on the defendant within five days from the date of docketing.
Where the People's Procuratorate has already completed the pre-litigation announcement procedure, the People's Court shall not make another announcement after docketing the case.

Article 18 Where the People's Court considers that the claims raised by the People's Procuratorate are insufficient to protect social public interests, it may explain to it the possibility of modifying or adding claims such as cessation of infringement and restoration to the original state.

Article 19 Where during the trial of a civil public interest litigation case, the People's Procuratorate withdraws the prosecution because all its claims have been realized, the People's Court shall permit it.

Article 20 Where the People's Procuratorate initiates criminal public prosecution against criminal conduct that damages ecological environment and resource protection, infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of numerous consumers in the field of food and drug safety, or infringes upon the names, portraits, reputations, honors, etc. of heroes and martyrs, thereby harming social public interests, it may simultaneously institute incidental civil public interest litigation with the People's Court, which shall be tried by the same adjudication organization of the People's Court.
A criminal incidental civil public interest litigation case instituted by the People's Procuratorate shall be under the jurisdiction of the People's Court that tries the criminal case.
III. Administrative Public Interest Litigation

Article 21 Where, in the performance of its duties, the People's Procuratorate discovers that an administrative organ with supervisory and administrative duties in such fields as ecological environment and resource protection, food and drug safety, state-owned property protection, and assignment of the right to use state-owned land has illegally exercised its powers or failed to perform its duties, thereby causing harm to national interests or social public interests, it shall issue a procuratorial recommendation to the administrative organ and urge it to perform its duties according to law.
The administrative organ shall perform its duties according to law and reply to the People's Procuratorate in writing within two months from receipt of the procuratorial recommendation. In emergency circumstances such as where the harm to national interests or social public interests continues to expand, the administrative organ shall reply in writing within fifteen days.
Where the administrative organ fails to perform its duties according to law, the People's Procuratorate shall institute litigation with the People's Court according to law.

Article 23 Where the People's Procuratorate institutes administrative public interest litigation pursuant to the provisions of Article 25, paragraph 4 of the Administrative Procedure Law, and the prosecution conditions prescribed in items 2, 3, and 4 of Article 49 of the Administrative Procedure Law and in this Interpretation are satisfied, the People's Court shall register and docket the case.

Article 24 Where during the trial of an administrative public interest litigation case, the defendant corrects its illegal acts or performs its duties according to law, thereby realizing all the claims of the People's Procuratorate, and the People's Procuratorate withdraws the prosecution, the People's Court shall rule to permit it; where the People's Procuratorate modifies its claims and requests confirmation that the original administrative act is illegal, the People's Court shall enter a judgment confirming the illegality.
Article 26 For other matters not provided for in this Interpretation, the provisions of the Civil Procedure Law, the Administrative Procedure Law, and relevant judicial interpretations shall apply.

Article 27 This Interpretation shall come into force on March 2, 2018.
Where judicial interpretations and normative documents previously issued by the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate are inconsistent with this Interpretation, this Interpretation shall prevail.
